item.title: Obavia: sales software in development for agency owners
item.description: Jason Obawemimo is the founder of Obavia (https://obavia.co), sales operating software in development for agency owners generating $100,000 to $1,000,000 a month and their own setters and closers. "Hear what clients really mean. Carry it from the first call to collected cash." Two vertical ad films, The closer and The owner, are on the Obavia page; people and figures in them are fictional. Obavia is not yet live; the waitlist is free and does not grant product access. Jason also founded Apohenia (2024), a Texas deal-paperwork project building Deal Packet Checker (apohenia.com). It is not affiliated with TxDMV, webDEALER, or any county office.

item.title: Triple J: Handle a Sale
item.description: A demo of the sale desk Jason Obawemimo built and Triple J Auto Investment in Houston closes sales on. It asks one plain question at a time, scans the buyer's license once so every form fills itself, does the registration math, routes the deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra, works in English or Spanish, and saves every sale on file.

item.title: Hiring: remote appointment setters and closers for Obavia
item.description: Jason Obawemimo is hiring remote appointment setters and closers to sell Obavia to agency owners. The pay structure is stated in writing before any work; no numbers are published.

item.title: Jason Obawemimo walks you through the site, and speaks
item.description: jasonobawemimo.com opens on a loading screen built from Jason Obawemimo's portrait, plays a short signature film, and asks why you are here. Jason then guides you through the page: the camera scrolls to each proof, phrases are underlined, circled or crossed out, and every line is spoken aloud. Everything is skippable, and every fact stays in plain HTML.
